Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Burnsville for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The season runs from December 4 (Tinsel, Treats and Giving with Santa photos and cookie decorating) through December 13, with the Community Nutcracker Event at the Mraz Center (December 5), Meet Santa at the Tru180 Showroom (December 12) and Twin City Ballet's A Minnesota Nutcracker at the Ames Center (December 11 to 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Burnsville

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Burnsville
  • 2 free events: Tinsel, Treats and Giving and Meet Santa at the Tru180 Showroom (register ahead)
  • Meet Santa: photos at Tinsel, Treats and Giving on December 4 and at the Tru180 Showroom on December 12
  • Shows: The Community Nutcracker Event ($15) and A Minnesota Nutcracker at the Ames Center
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Winter Lighting Ceremony was November 25
  • Season: December 4 to December 13, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Burnsville families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Orpheum and Guthrie holiday shows, the CPKC Holiday Train, Christkindl Market and the Minnesota Streetcar Museum.
